name: Kitazato Corporation
summary: Kitazato Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, and markets medical devices, reagents, and related products for fertility treatment. It offers needles, catheters and cannulas, vitrification media and equipment, sperm processing medium/tools, IVF medium products, micro tools, and labware products. The company was formerly known as Kitazato Biopharma Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Shizuoka, Japan. Kitazato Corporation is a subsidiary of Kitasato Shoji Co., Ltd.
